intro: Innkeeper Saelienne manages the inn situated on the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus. She provides weary travelers and local artisans with food, drink, and a peaceful hearthstone retreat in the heart of the night elven capital.

p: Situated amidst the bustling workshops and trade stalls of the Craftsmen's Terrace, Innkeeper Saelienne offers a calm respite for both residents and visitors to Darnassus. As a keeper of the hearth, she caters to adventurers arriving from across Kalimdor and beyond, serving staple night elven refreshments alongside goods brought into the city port. Her establishment serves as a primary gathering place for tradesfolk seeking rest after long hours at the forge or loom.
